issues.description:
** The waiver gate can still approve a failed gdigrab measurement when the run-count bar fails.
- **Category:** Correctness
- **Severity:** Major
- **Evidence paths:** `tools/dabbler-ai-orchestration/scripts/record-vscode-walkthrough.js:1195-1265`, `tools/dabbler-ai-orchestration/scripts/record-vscode-walkthrough.js:1320-1345`, `tools/dabbler-ai-orchestration/scripts/measure-gdigrab-capture.js:1041-1068`, `docs/session-sets/113-narrated-video-walkthroughs/s4-pilot-criteria.json:7-18`
- **Failure scenario:** A Session 9/later remeasurement has C7 as the only criterion-level unmet item but produces fewer than the required ten clean runs because one desktop/caption/capture run is noisy or the measurement is shortened. That is probable enough that the pilot has an explicit multi-run bar. The current gate approves the C7 waiver before checking `evaluation.verdict`/`barRunsMet`, so a failed pilot can unlock capture anyway.
- **Acceptance criterion:** `node -e "fs=require('fs'),real=fs.readFileSync,fs.readFileSync=function(p,e){return p=String(p),p.endsWith('s8-gdigrab-capture-measurement.json')?JSON.stringify({evaluation:{verdict:'FAIL',barRunsMet:false,unmet:['C7']}}):p.endsWith('s8-operator-waiver.json')?JSON.stringify({waivedBy:'operator',attestation:'waives only C7 mechanism',scope:{appliesToBackend:'ffmpeg-gdigrab-desktop'},waivedCriteria:[{id:'C7'}]}):real(p,e)},r=require('./tools/dabbler-ai-orchestration/scripts/record-vscode-walkthrough.js'),a=r.captureApproval('gdigrab'),process.exit(a.approved?1:0)"`
- **Acceptance expectation:** exit 0
- **Details:** Violation: the committed criteria say “Any criterion unmet, or fewer than ten consecutive clean runs, is a FAIL,” and the recorder contract says a failed pilot ships no recorder. Impact: a reasonable reviewer cannot trust the gate, because an operator waiver for one criterion can mask an unwaived failure of the pass bar. Evidence: `waiverCoverage` only compares `evaluation.unmet` to `waivedCriteria`; `captureApproval` returns approved from that waiver branch before the later `evaluation.verdict === "PASS"` check; `evaluate()` independently makes the verdict `FAIL` when `cleanRuns < bar.runs`.
